remarks: Welcome to this stunning brand-new 2026-built detached home nestled in the sought-after community of Rosemont in Edmonton's west end. Thoughtfully designed for modern family living, this 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom home offers the perfect blend of style, comfort, and functionality. From the moment you arrive, you'll appreciate the fresh, contemporary finishes and the pride that comes with owning a never-lived-in property. Rosenthal is a vibrant, family-friendly neighbourhood with parks, pathways, and convenient access to shopping, schools, and major roadways making everyday life effortless. Whether you're a growing family or a savvy buyer looking for a move-in-ready new build, this home checks every box. (id:67522)
